title: Maximum Frequency Stack
description: Design a stack-like data structure that pushes elements and pops the most frequent element.
pseudocode:
1: freqMap[val]++
2: maxFreq = Math.max(maxFreq, freqMap[val])
3: group[freqMap[val]].push(val)
4: val = group[maxFreq].pop()
5: freqMap[val]--
6: if group[maxFreq].length == 0: maxFreq--

steps.note: Pop: Max frequency is 2. Element 5 is popped.
Update: freqMap[5] becomes 1. Max frequency drops to 1.
